environment: isolated Docker Compose; PostgreSQL 18; two API replicas

cases.name: missing, malformed, expired, wrong-audience, wrong-issuer and forged tokens are rejected
read-only scope can read balances but cannot create or cancel orders
ownership and identity-header substitution cannot expose or cancel another account order
API identity cannot read base tables, perform DDL, rewrite ledger or assume an owner role
API and worker cannot invoke each other operations; migration has separate authority
concurrent idempotent submissions across replicas reserve and charge quota only once
simultaneous submissions cannot overspend and a rejected request creates no reservation
shared per-account quota survives replica switching and preserves other users and retries
concurrent admission stops at the configured shared capacity without reserving rejected funds
cancellation works during admission closure and the worker releases funds exactly once
invalid amounts, SQL-shaped input and direct database validation bypass attempts fail closed
security-definer functions have a non-login owner, pinned path and no PUBLIC execution grant

scope: Security lab only. No AWS changes and no Problem 1 runtime dependencies. This is not a penetration test or performance benchmark.
